name: acme-partner-access-path
description: ILLUSTRATIVE Approach-2 example (parallel program + shared interface contract) for firewall-policy-use-case.md — an end-to-end partner-HTTPS security policy across a THREE-VENDOR firewall path (edge Palo Alto / dmz AWS security group / core Cisco ASA). NOT runnable as-is: no live PAN-OS / ASA / AWS read-only harvest service is wired, and the pan-os / cisco-asa domain protocols are notional (a real run would add them as a use-case config exercise, per ADD-A-PIPELINE-HARNESS-AGENT.md). This is a design worked-example, not a demo artifact.

endToEndFlow.notes: NO source NAT anywhere on this path — every hop matches the partner CIDR VERBATIM. That absence of NAT is exactly why this is Approach 2 (all interdependencies are declarative constants the Architect resolves up front). Add a NAT at edge-fw and it becomes Approach 3 (downstream must match post-NAT addresses only known after the edge design runs).
